params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: In the home audience section the capitals are set too large, and on a laptop-width screen the "agencies and media" block runs over the end of the "brands and strategy teams" text.

## What is wrong

The section places its three blocks absolutely inside a box of fixed proportions (`lg:aspect-[1370/430]`), and the lines are set at `clamp(1.35rem, 2.2vw, 2.1rem)`. Around 1280 px wide, the brands text needs about seven lines and runs below 55% of the box height, where the agencies block starts. A screenshot from 12 November shows "YOU ALREADY SENSE." under "For agencies and media".

Expected: the three blocks never touch at any width from `lg` up, and the type sits closer to the size of the section heading.

Source: Portal mail:49.
params.title: Home audience section: capitals too large, the agencies block overlaps the brands text at laptop width
